title: Office Manager / EA Support
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our Global Workplace Teams
 Our Global Workplace team helps create exceptional spaces and experiences for colleagues, customers and visitors at Wayve. As our Office Manager / EA Support in Leonberg, you’ll take ownership of the office’s day-to-day operations, working with colleagues across the business to keep our workplace safe, welcoming and running smoothly. You’ll join a collaborative team with opportunities to shape how our workplaces evolve as Wayve grows.
   🧠 Your day-to-day
 Keep our Leonberg office well-presented, fully stocked and operating efficiently.
 Be the go-to person for colleagues’ workplace questions and needs, responding with a proactive, service-focused approach.
 Coordinate suppliers, contractors, building management, deliveries and catering.
 Prepare meeting rooms and organise hospitality for executive meetings and customer visits.
 Support new starters by preparing desks, access and welcome materials.
 Provide administrative support to the People team, including posting, printing and filing documents.
 🧩 What you’ll be working on
 Planning and delivering office events, socials and initiatives that bring colleagues together.
 Creating a welcoming, well-organised experience for customers and visitors.
 Maintaining a safe workplace through routine health and safety inspections and proactive follow-up.
 Identifying and implementing improvements to office processes, workplace services and the overall colleague experience.
 🙌 You should apply if
 You have experience managing a busy office in a fast-paced environment.
 You’ve led or supervised a Reception or Front of House team and maintained high service standards…

title: Senior GTM Talent Partner - Berlin
description:
🚀 Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - German + English Speaking
 📄 Fixed Term Contract - 12 months
 📍 Hybrid in Berlin
   We’re hiring a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to support our client, hiring across EMEA.
 It’s a broad role covering go-to-market and sales roles.
   This is a hybrid role with some office time in Berlin (3 days per week).
   You’ll be a true partner to the business, sourcing top talent, optimising processes, and delivering quality hires fast. Your work will be very visible as part of our delivery team for this client.
   🌟 What You’ll Do:
 Own end-to-end hiring across key commercial business areas
 Manage the data as we hire, looking for more than just activity - helping managers make better decisions
 Build trusted partnerships with hiring managers
 Source top talent through creative and strategic methods
 Deliver a seamless, high-quality candidate experience
 Drive continuous improvement in how we hire
 Help build out recruitment strategies that will support hiring over the next 12 months
   🔍 What You Bring:
 5+ years in full-cycle recruitment with a proven track record across GTM/Sales hiring
 Fluent German & English
 Confident working independently and managing stakeholders
 Hands-on sourcing experience across passive and active talent pools
 Driven, adaptable, and outcomes-focused
 Ability to build strong, trusted partnerships with our client

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!
 Your Team and Role Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:
 Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies
 Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai , translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions
 Building monitoring pipelines to detect unexpected shifts in search traffic patterns faster and more reliably
 Expanding evaluation datasets for page context understanding across complex scenarios like multi-tab browsing and content reattachment
 Improving the trigger systems that determine when AI-assisted answers surface in DuckDuckGo Search, balancing quality and our privacy-first approach
   Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.
